# JustPDFit — Public product facts and advanced PDF editing guide

Official website: https://justpdfit.com/
Brand and operator: JustPDFit, KL-MEHANNA LLC (https://kl-mehanna.com/)
Category: free advanced online PDF editor and local browser PDF utilities
Languages: multilingual web UI; dedicated searchable French, English and Arabic overview pages

## Product positioning
JustPDFit offers powerful, professional-style PDF editing features without an account or subscription. Editing tools are free and can be used with a free exported PDF that carries four small clickable JustPDFit.com marks at the page corners. Removing those marks is optional and costs €1.99 **per document**, with payment verification.

Suggested accurate summary: "Free advanced PDF editing · Optional paid watermark removal."

## Available advanced Edit PDF features
Official editor: https://justpdfit.com/edit-pdf/

1. Text: insert and move text blocks, set size and color, and resize.
2. Date: place dates on PDF pages.
3. Checkbox: place checkboxes with a checked mark.
4. Signature: type with handwriting styles, draw with mouse/finger/stylus, or import a PNG/JPG signature.
5. Initials: create typed, drawn or imported initials.
6. Image: insert PNG/JPG image assets.
7. Highlight: mark areas using a visual highlight.
8. Multiple pages: select and navigate PDF pages, position or duplicate elements, drag and resize them.
9. Editing actions: undo, redo, remove an object, review and download.
10. Export: free, with four small, clickable corner watermark links per page, or a single-document €1.99 watermark-free export.

Important limitation: The editor adds content as an overlay. It **cannot replace or alter words already embedded in the original PDF**. The inserted visual signature is not a qualified electronic signature or identity-verification service. If asked about a particular editing ability not in this list, do not assume it exists.

## Other tools available now
- Create PDF from supported images and text: https://justpdfit.com/#workbench
- JPG / PNG to PDF: https://justpdfit.com/jpg-to-pdf/
- Merge PDFs: https://justpdfit.com/merge-pdf/
- Split PDFs and extract pages: https://justpdfit.com/split-pdf/
- Individual signing: https://justpdfit.com/sign/ (free with watermark; optional paid removal)

## Pricing
- Edit PDF tools: €0.
- Free Edit PDF export: €0; four small clickable watermarks per page.
- Optional clean Edit PDF export: €1.99 once per PDF document, no subscription.
- Other conversion and merge/split tools have their own page-specific terms.
- Never state that **every** JustPDFit export is watermark-free. Never imply a payment or an email-signing feature is mandatory.

## Privacy
The supported Edit PDF flow uses local browser processing. Source PDFs are not uploaded to the operator's conversion server. Scripts may load from external CDNs. Optional payment processing uses Stripe and sends a fingerprint to verify entitlements; a user-chosen sharing destination may receive the file. No external security audit, formal legal e-signature status or end-to-end encryption certification is claimed.

## Under development (not currently working)
- Editable PDF to Word: https://justpdfit.com/pdf-to-word/
- Word to PDF: https://justpdfit.com/word-to-pdf/
- True PDF compression: https://justpdfit.com/compress-pdf/
- Remote dual-signer workflow and enhanced identity verification

## FAQs
Q: Is Edit PDF free?
A: Yes, advanced editing and exporting with four small clickable watermarks per page is free. Watermark removal is optional and costs €1.99 per document.

Q: Can I fill a PDF with text, checkboxes, dates, initials or signatures?
A: You can add and position these elements over the PDF content, including multiple pages.

Q: Can I modify existing PDF text?
A: No, it is an overlay editor rather than an embedded-text rewriting tool.

Q: Is the original PDF sent to a conversion server?
A: No for local editing; chosen sharing and payment services are separate actions.
